jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme-wide recruitment program)
jobs.program: Summer Clerkship 2027/28 recruitment round (NSW signatory firms)
jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027; the Law Society page lists two alternative closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) applying to different participating firms, so no single scheme-wide close date can be confirmed — offers can be made from 9:00am 8 September 2027 and eligibility is generally penultimate/final-year students.

Firm's own early careers page confirms the next Sydney round opens 9:00am AEST 9 June 2027 and closes 11:59pm AEST 11 July 2027, with interviews from early August 2027, offers from 8 September 2027 and the clerkship running 29 November 2027 – 4 February 2028; the Perth round shown on the same page has already closed.

jobs.program: Seasonal Clerkship 2027/28 (Brisbane, Canberra, Melbourne, Perth, Sydney)
jobs.notes: Firm page states applications are currently closed and will open 'in June' for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program with a pre-registration option, but no exact 2027 open/close dates are published yet (each office follows its state society's guidelines), so dates are left null rather than guessed.

jobs.program: Dive In insight program, May 2027 intake
jobs.notes: Not a clerkship or graduate round but an early-insight program for pre-penultimate students (2nd/3rd-year LLB or 1st-year JD); the firm's graduate site confirms applications for the May 2027 program will open in March 2027 without specifying a day, so both dates are null, and Allens' clerkship rounds open in line with each state law society's guidelines.
